name: Chibiverse
description: Join your fan-favorite Disney Branded Television characters as they host a showcase to celebrate their wild Chibi Tiny Tales adventures, including Phineas and Ferb, Cricket Green, Anne Boonchuy, Molly McGee, Penny Proud and more.

videos.title: Pizza vs. Fireworks
videos.overview: Molly McGee and Tilly Green bring us adventures from all across the Chibiverse! Scratch and Cricket Green argue over whether to end their show with a pizza party or with fireworks!

videos.title: Bad Luck Chibis
videos.overview: Anne Boonchuy and Sprig Plantar are co-hosting the Chibiverse with Cricket and Tilly Green. But when Hop Pop breaks a theatre superstition, their show starts to turn spooky!

videos.title: The Great Chibi Mix-Up
videos.overview: Phineas & Ferb have planned a Chibi dance off, but when Dr. Doof makes all the Chibis forget who their real besties are, Phineas & Ferb work with Luz to try and set things right.

videos.title: Chibi Villains Unite
videos.overview: Penny and Molly are excited to present an adorable Chibi Pet Parade. That is until a group of sinister Chibi villains, led by King Andrias, arrive to take over the Chibiverse!

videos.title: The Chibi Quiz Challenge
videos.overview: Everyone's favorite fun-loving squirrel, Kiff, hosts a game show challenging Chibis to answer questions based on some of their favorite adventures.

videos.title: The Chibi Couple Game
videos.overview: Starco & Lumity are competing in a Couples Game show! But when Scott accidentally signs him and Hailey up, will Hailey be forced to reveal her true feelings in front of everyone?

videos.title: The Roast Of Dr. Doofenshmirtz
videos.overview: Dr. Doofenshmirtz from Phineas and Ferb is in the hot seat as Tater, Scratch, Marcy, and Perry the Platypus take the stage to roast everyone's favorite evil scientist playfully!

videos.title: Grown Ups Island
videos.overview: When a scientist's breadcrumb falls onto the Chibiverse and creates a new island, the Chibi grown-ups claim it all for themselves to the Chibi children's dismay! But Cricket Green, Kiff Chatterley and Tater Ramirez Humphrey vow to make their way onto "Grown-Ups Island" no matter what it takes!

videos.title: Opposites Attack
videos.overview: When Marcy Wu asks the witch, Helen, for a spell to be less clumsy, Marcy accidentally unleashes a magic potion across the Chibiverse that turns all the Chibis into their total opposites! Now Marcy and Helen must restore order and face off against the Chibiverse’s newest baddie… Molly McMean!

videos.title: Stan's 11
videos.overview: When Scrooge McDuck invites anyone in the Chibiverse to test out his new security system, Grunkle Stan puts together a crew to pull of the ultimate heist: breaking into the Money Bin!

videos.title: Dr. Doof's Lab
videos.overview: The eccentric Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz welcomes Cricket Green, Kiff Chatterley, Marco Diaz, and Kim Possible to tour his lab to find out which one should be his new evil intern!

videos.title: Journey to the Center of the Chibiverse
videos.overview: When Remy Remington gets trapped underground after a Chibiquake, Vasquez teams up with Star Butterfly and Phineas and Ferb to save Remy from whatever lurks on the planet!

videos.title: The Perfect Gift
videos.overview: When Luz realizes her “Chibiversary” with Amity is coming up, she sets out on an epic adventure to find the legendary “Perfect Gift.”

videos.title: Penny Proud and the Chibi Scouts
videos.overview: Oscar Proud is concerned that his daughter, Penny Proud, has been spending too much time with the Villain Kids, so he signs her up for the seemingly wholesome Chibi Scouts.

videos.title: Quackstreet Boys
videos.overview: In this behind-the-music style documentary, we learn about the rise and fall of the iconic Chibi boy band, The Quackstreet Boys.

videos.title: Cheer Up Chibis
videos.overview: When gloomy music from the scientists’ lab makes everyone sad in the Chibiverse, Addison and Bucky must put together an elite cheerleading squad to cheer up the planet!

videos.title: Mabel's Dream Date
videos.overview: When the Chibi Hawkins dance approaches, Mabel Pines can’t find a single Chibi that meets her dating standards! So she asks Gyro Gearloose to build her the perfect “dream date.”

videos.title: Grandparent-Napped!
videos.overview: When Tater’s grandparents are mysteriously captured along with the other senior citizens of the Chibiverse, Tater teams up with Perry the Platypus to rescue them all!

videos.title: Space Race
videos.overview: Join Hailey Banks and the Chibis as they race Lord Hater to the legendary Pepperoni Moon! With Phineas and Ferb and more friends along for the ride, who will win the ultimate space race?

videos.title: Chibivengers
videos.overview: Dr. Doof traps all the heroes and tries to take over the Chibiverse.

videos.title: Star Butterfly Effect
videos.overview: Phineas time-travels with Merian to fix a party.

videos.title: Kiff Possible
videos.overview: Kiff and Barry must save Kim Possible from Lord Hater.

videos.title: Candace's Old Year Resolutions
videos.overview: Candace tries to finish all her New Year's resolutions in one day.

videos.title: The Snowball Battle Royale
videos.overview: Chibis battle for hot cocoa in a snowball war.

videos.title: The Love Boat Liars
videos.overview: Helen and Scratch pretend to be a couple to board a cruise ship.

videos.title: Lost Pets
videos.overview: Perry helps lost Chibi-pets find their way back home.

videos.title: Mystery Busters
videos.overview: Webby, Andromeda, and Pliny must save the Chibiverse!

videos.title: Return of Pebble
videos.overview: Cricket, Remy, and Star protect Pebble from thieves.
